transfer_taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on deeds
transfer_taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.70 per $100 (all counties except Miami-Dade). All parties are liable; seller customarily pays (custom not stated on DOR page).

transfer_taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on mortgage/note
transfer_taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.35 per $100; no cap for recorded mortgages (unsecured notes capped at $2,450).

transfer_taxes.name: Florida nonrecurring intangible tax on mortgage
transfer_taxes.source_title: Fla. Stat. 199.133; Florida DOR Nonrecurring Intangible Tax
transfer_taxes.notes: 2 mills per dollar. DOR (https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/taxesfees/Pages/nonrecurring_intangible_tax.aspx): lender is the taxpayer liable but may pass cost to borrower.
